method.method_draft: Use similar triangles. From the rectangle, CD is parallel to AB and CD=AB=5. Since DF=1 and GC=2, the remaining segment FG on CD has length FG=5-1-2=2. Because FG lies on CD, FG is parallel to AB. In triangle EAB, segment FG cuts sides EA and EB and is parallel to base AB, so triangle EFG is similar to triangle EAB. Let h be the perpendicular height from E to AB. Since CD is 3 units above AB, the perpendicular height from E to FG is h-3. Similarity gives (h-3)/h = FG/AB = 2/5. Solving, 5h-15=2h, so h=5. Therefore area of triangle AEB is (1/2)(AB)(h)=(1/2)(5)(5)=25/2.
